user_query: I am planning a surprise anniversary party for my parents and need some ideas for a memorable celebration. Can you suggest unique themes, decorations, and activities? Additionally, I would like to gather some heartwarming stories of successful anniversary parties.

TaskList.description: Research unique themes for anniversary parties
Find decoration ideas that match selected themes
Gather activities that can enhance the party experience
Collect heartwarming stories of successful anniversary parties
Compile all ideas and stories into a presentation or document
